To address these EHS challenges, 4Front Engineering turned to SoterAI, an innovative AI platform designed to streamline safety processes and reduce administrative burdens.
Speeding Up Policy and Procedure Writing

Writing and updating safety policies and procedures is a basic but often disliked task for EHS folks like Tim, who would rather be out on the floor. It wasn't just the writing; they also had to make sure everything was clearly laid out, covered all the bases, and met standards like ISO if needed.

SoterAI offered a much better way to start. 4Front Engineering found that the platform could give them good outlines and starting content for many policies. Tim's team could even upload their current company policies or related documents, like ANSI standards or ISO guides, and the AI would use that information to make its suggestions more relevant.

This new approach greatly reduced the busy work that usually comes with creating policies. Instead of starting with a blank document, the EHS team got a solid draft from SoterAI, letting them focus on fine-tuning the content and adding details specific to their site.

At 4FRONT's plants, employees were often handling oversized materials like 12-foot vinyl pads or assembling shelters with fixtures that no longer worked as intended. These jobs weren't heavy, but they were awkward, leading to unnecessary strain and inefficiencies.

To improve safety, efficiency, and comfort in the work area, 4Front Engineered Solutions utilizes dock seals, dock lights, trailer restraints, impactable dock doors, and HVLS fans. Epic Fans and HVLS fans from 4Front Engineered Solutions help reduce hot spots, tackle condensation, and improve airflow and energy savings in facilities.

To tackle these issues, the team began recording quick two-minute videos of shop floor tasks and uploading them into SoterAI. The system flagged ergonomic risks, suggested improvements, and even calculated ROI on potential solutions.
By connecting ergonomic safety directly to ROI, the team reduced risk, improved efficiency, and built a stronger business case for investing in worker well-being.
Getting Safety Info to Frontline Workers

Think about a worker on the floor who needs to know the safety steps for a specific machine, like "press number four," right now. Waiting for a supervisor or a safety team member to find the document isn't just slow; it can be unsafe if the job continues without the right instructions.

SoterAI provided a way to solve this by letting companies like 4Front Engineering upload their own safety documents, such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and machine-specific lockout steps, into the system. This meant that frontline workers could be given access to ask the system directly.

For example, an employee could ask SoterAI, "How do I lock out press number four?" and get the correct, company-approved steps on their device. This direct and instant access to important safety information made it available to everyone in the plant, leading to a better-informed and more safety-conscious culture on the factory floor.
